origin: Named after the box lit from below that photographers laid film slides on. Lokesh Dhakar's 2005 JavaScript library Lightbox spread the name on the web.
whenToUse: People look closely at one photo from a list.
People page through several photos large.
Photos need enlarging on small screens.
whenNotToUse: The photos are already large enough.
Lots of information must be seen alongside the photo (use a detail page).
People only choose one photo (use an image gallery).
accessibility: Open a native dialog with showModal to block the page behind and trap focus.
←/→ page through photos, and closing with Esc returns focus to the thumbnail that was pressed.
Announce the position ("2 of 4") with aria-live and show the caption in a figcaption.
Thumbnail button names say what they open, such as "View Seoul Forest path large".
